title: LinkLayer restart loses inbound replay, pin, rekey, and retired-key security state
description: Security review: persisted state contains only TX epoch/sequence; replay floors/bitmaps, pinned/rekeyed peers, and retired remote keys are volatile and persistence errors are silently ignored. Restart can accept captured signed traffic and retired old-key traffic. Add crash-safe authenticated persistence for required RX replay/trust/rekey lineage, fail closed on corrupt/rollback state, and test restart replay plus retired-key rejection.
